## Privacy checklist (public repo — this matters)

- [ ] No secrets, API keys, tokens, or credentials
- [ ] No personal email addresses (other than the published maintainer contact)
- [ ] No real absolute paths — use placeholders like `/Users/you/...`
- [ ] No client, employer, or private project names
- [ ] The **Guard — secrets & personal data** check passes
